tools.name: analyzeContent
tools.title: AI-powered debate card analysis
tools.description:
AI-powered debate card analysis

Sends debate card content to an LLM (Groq LLaMA 3.3 70B) for analysis.
By default, it identifies the main claim, summarizes warrants, assigns a
support score (0–10), lists flaws, and suggests a cross-examination question.
A custom prompt can override the default analysis.

POST /api/analyze

content.description: The debate card / research quote text to analyze.

customPrompt.description: Optional custom prompt to replace the default flaw-finding analysis. The content is appended after the prompt.

tools.name: listVideos
tools.title: Get a page of debate videos
tools.description:
Get a page of debate videos

Returns one page of the debate video library. Videos are stored in SQL
(Cloudflare D1) and filtered, searched, sorted and paginated
server-side, so clients page through the library as the grid is
scrolled rather than downloading the whole dataset. Season topics,
champions and library-wide counts live on `/videos/meta`.

GET /api/videos

lecturesOnly.description: Set to `1` to keep only videos with no numeric debate style.

topPicks.description: Set to `1` to keep only editorially selected top picks.

style.description: Debate format — 1 Policy, 2 PF, 3 LD, 4 College.

year.description: Season year (e.g. `2026`) or `legacy` for pre-2010 content.

q.description: Free-text search over title, channel and description.

sort.description: `Views` for most viewed, `Recency` (default) for newest first.

limit.description: Page size; defaults to 60, capped at 200.

offset.description: Zero-based offset of the requested page.

facets.description: Set to `1` to include per-season and per-style counts.

tools.name: searchCards
tools.title: Search debate research cards
tools.description:
Search debate research cards

Full-text search across debate evidence cards with filtering by year, school,
team, tournament, and event. Supports scoped search (highlighted text only,
underlined text only, summaries, block/file titles, or all text). Results
can be sorted by relevance, read count, year, or highlight length.

GET /api/search

sort.description: Sort field and direction, colon-separated. Fields: `_text_match`, `readCount`, `year`, `highlightLength`. Directions: `asc`, `desc`.

school.description: Filter by school name (case-insensitive partial match).

team.description: Filter by team code (case-insensitive partial match).

tournament.description: Filter by tournament name (case-insensitive partial match).

event.description: Filter by event type (e.g., CX, LD, PF). Use `all` for no filter.

searchHighlighted.description: When `1`, restrict search to highlighted (`<mark>`) text only.

searchUnderlined.description: When `1`, restrict search to underlined (`<u>`) text only.

searchSummaries.description: When `1`, restrict search to card summaries only.

searchBlockAndFileTitles.description: When `1`, restrict search to argument block and research field titles.

searchAllText.description: When `1`, search all text fields (overrides other scope flags).
